native_browser_ui.qualification: Actual native Codex terminal plugin-browser installation and fresh-chat MCP discovery
native_ui_flow: Open /plugins in a fresh isolated Codex profile.
Select Add Marketplace and enter the public Git repository URL.
Open the pinned Progress Checker plugin details and select Install plugin.
Confirm the native browser shows Progress Checker installed and enabled at 0.4.0-dev, with its planning skill.
Start a new chat in the current disposable checkout.
Open /mcp and confirm progress_checker: connected (11 tools).
native_browser_ui.mcp_connection_owner: Native Codex process; no manual MCP client used for this UI proof

evidence.capture_description: Original PTY bytes and decoded live terminal states. PNG captures render those terminal text states; they are not desktop screenshots.

coverage_limits: This proof covers native browser installation, enabled skill discovery, a fresh chat, and Codex-owned MCP connection with an eleven-tool count.
Individual tool names are covered by separate native backend evidence.
No model conversation, Track this project request, human check approval, or configured-check execution was performed.
No universal public directory listing or independent-machine compatibility claim is made.

source_free_native_browser.coverage: Source-free native marketplace CLI and browser backend plugin/install, discovery and plugin/uninstall; exact frozen file bytes and modes, with portable installed MCP tool discovery.

limits: Custom Git marketplace, not universal public-directory listing.
Fedora 44 x86_64 only; other platforms unqualified.
Older active writer requires one-time close/reopen during upgrade.
Native default preserves ordinary default state, not custom legacy bindings.
Podman development recipient allows nested namespaces with seccomp=unconfined,label=disable,unmask=ALL; no host mounts/network/capabilities added.
